# [PR #409] feat: add top_k_sampling_from_probs_v163840 definition (Kimi K2.6)

source: https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer-bench/pull/409

## 正文

$## Summary

Adds the `top_k_sampling_from_probs_v163840` kernel definition for **Kimi K2.6** (`moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6`), which uses tokenizer `vocab_size=163840` (distinct from Kimi K2's `v=160000`). This definition is needed to track the top-k sampling kernel when serving Kimi K2.6 at TP=8 with FP8 quantization.

This PR adds:
- Definition JSON: `flashinfer_trace/definitions/sampling/top_k_sampling_from_probs_v163840.json`
- Reference test: `flashinfer_trace/tests/references/test_top_k_sampling_from_probs_v163840.py`
- Model coverage update: new **Kimi K2.6** section added to `docs/model_coverage.mdx`, status 🟡 for the new definition (will upgrade to ✅ once PR2 lands workloads + eval).

## Kernel details

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Op type | `sampling` |
| FlashInfer API | `flashinfer.sampling.top_k_sampling_from_probs` |
| `vocab_size` (const) | 163840 |
| `batch_size` (var) | runtime |
| Inputs | `probs[batch_size, 163840] float32`, `top_k[batch_size] int32` |
| Outputs | `samples[batch_size] int64` |
| Model | `moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6` |
| Serving config | TP=8, EP=1, quantization=fp8 |

Reference implementation follows the same pattern as other `top_k_sampling_from_probs_v*` definitions (Python/PyTorch sort+filter+multinomial); no FlashInfer dependency in the reference path.

## Reference test stdout

```
============================= test session starts ==============================
platform linux -- Python 3.12.13, pytest-9.0.3, pluggy-1.6.0
collected 1 item

flashinfer_trace/tests/references/test_top_k_sampling_from_probs_v163840.py::test_correctness PASSED [100%]
----------------------------- Captured stdout call -----------------------------
batch_size=4: max_freq_diff=0.0160 PASSED
=================== 1 passed, 1 warning in 76.66s (0:01:16) ====================
```

The test runs 5000 Monte-Carlo trials and compares empirical token-frequency distributions between the reference implementation and `flashinfer.sampling.top_k_sampling_from_probs`. Max frequency diff `0.0160 < 0.05` threshold.
